description: Free, open-source file toolkit for PDFs, images, video and audio. Compress, convert, OCR, remove backgrounds and transcribe on your own server with one Docker command. 200+ tools, local AI, REST API. An alternative to iLovePDF, CloudConvert and remove.bg.
